answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the garden of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Work waits on the pearl until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round.
